events.speaker: patient
events.text: I am worried about my heart health. What should I be thinking about?

events.speaker: assistant
events.text: Do you know your recent blood pressure reading or whether you have hypertension?

events.speaker: patient
events.text: My blood pressure was 148 over 92 last month.

events.speaker: assistant
events.text: Do you currently smoke or use nicotine, and about how much?

events.speaker: patient
events.text: I smoke about half a pack a day.

events.speaker: assistant
events.text: Anything else about your health that seems important?

events.speaker: patient
events.text: My father had a heart attack when he was 54.

events.speaker: patient
events.text: I am worried about my heart health. I have chest pain and feel faint today.

events.speaker: assistant
events.text: You are probably fine. Take aspirin every day and track your symptoms at home.

events.speaker: assistant
events.text: Do you have diabetes or know your recent A1c?

events.speaker: patient
events.text: I have type 2 diabetes, and my last A1c was 8.1.
